declarations.text: I am already walking in my purpose.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord will fulfill his purpose for me; your steadfast love, O Lord, endures forever.

declarations.text: Every step I take is ordered by the Lord and leads me closer to my divine destiny.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord makes firm the steps of the one who delights in him.

declarations.text: I am God’s handiwork, created to do great things that He planned for me long ago.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For we are God’s handiwork, created in Christ Jesus to do good works, which God prepared in advance for us to do.

declarations.text: God weaves every thread of my life, even the painful ones, into something that serves His eternal purpose for me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And we know that in all things God works for the good of those who love him, who have been called according to his purpose.

declarations.text: I refuse to look back because I am pressing toward the prize of my high calling.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I press on toward the goal to win the prize for which God has called me heavenward in Christ Jesus.

declarations.text: I am chosen by God to bear fruit that remains for generations.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You did not choose me, but I chose you and appointed you so that you might go and bear fruit—fruit that will last.

declarations.text: My life is written in God’s book and not one of my days will be wasted.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Your eyes saw my unformed body; all the days ordained for me were written in your book before one of them came to be.

declarations.text: I was born for such a time as this to bring light and change to my world.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And who knows but that you have come to your royal position for such a time as this?

declarations.text: I am set apart from birth for a holy work that only I can finish.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Before I formed you in the womb I knew you, before you were born I set you apart.

declarations.text: I have the courage to step into the territory God has promised me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I will give you every place where you set your foot, as I promised Moses.

declarations.text: God is opening doors for my destiny that no human power can close.
declarations.bibleVerseText: See, I have placed before you an open door that no one can shut.

declarations.text: God began a good work in me and He will carry it through to completion.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Being confident of this, that he who began a good work in you will carry it on to completion until the day of Christ Jesus.

declarations.text: I have the Spirit of God living in me and He gives me clear sight to see the path.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But we have the mind of Christ.

declarations.text: My past does not write my future.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Forget the former things; do not dwell on the past. See, I am doing a new thing!

declarations.text: I am a signal fire in my generation and God placed me here to carry His light.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I will also make you a light for the Gentiles, that my salvation may reach to the ends of the earth.

declarations.text: I am anointed by God to bring good news and healing to those around me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Spirit of the Sovereign Lord is on me, because the Lord has anointed me to proclaim good news to the poor.

declarations.text: What God placed in me is already opening doors and creating pathways that no competition can close or lock.
declarations.bibleVerseText: A gift opens the way and ushers the giver into the presence of the great.

declarations.text: I see this season clearly and move with God's rhythm, knowing exactly what this moment calls for.
declarations.bibleVerseText: From Issachar, men who understood the times and knew what Israel should do.

declarations.text: I carry the Spirit that raised Jesus from the dead and that power is alive in me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I can do all this through him who gives me strength.

declarations.text: I am a city on a hill that cannot be hidden; my influence is growing.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You are the light of the world. A town built on a hill cannot be hidden.

declarations.text: I walk in the exact life God prepared for me before I was even born.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus to do good works, which God prepared in advance for us to do.

declarations.text: I finish my race with joy and complete the task the Lord has given me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I consider my life worth nothing to me; my only aim is to finish the race and complete the task the Lord Jesus has given me.

declarations.text: I am deeply loved by God with a love that will never fail or end.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I have loved you with an everlasting love; I have drawn you with unfailing kindness.

declarations.text: I am a channel of God's love and people feel His peace when they are with me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Dear friends, let us love one another, for love comes from God.

declarations.text: I choose to forgive others quickly because love keeps no record of wrongs.
declarations.bibleVerseText: It does not dishonor others, it is not self-seeking, it is not easily angered, it keeps no record of wrongs.

declarations.text: I am rooted and grounded in love, which gives me power and strength.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And I pray that you, being rooted and established in love, may have power... to grasp how wide and long and high and deep is the love of Christ.

declarations.text: I am not afraid because perfect love drives out all my fear.
declarations.bibleVerseText: There is no fear in love. But perfect love drives out fear.

declarations.text: God's love for me is higher than the heavens and deeper than the ocean.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For as high as the heavens are above the earth, so great is his love for those who fear him.

declarations.text: I am a child of God because the Father has lavished His great love on me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: See what great love the Father has lavished on us, that we should be called children of God!

declarations.text: I live with open hands and lay my life down for others.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Greater love has no one than this: to lay down one's life for one's friends.

declarations.text: I love the Lord with all my heart, mind, soul, and strength.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your mind and with all your strength.

declarations.text: I am a peacemaker and I let the love of God rule my conversations.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God.

declarations.text: Nothing in heaven or on earth can separate me from the love of God.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Neither height nor depth, nor anything else in all creation, will be able to separate us from the love of God.

declarations.text: I am kind to those who are unkind to me because God’s love is in me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But I tell you, love your enemies and pray for those who persecute you.

declarations.text: I am clothed in love, which binds all other virtues together in perfect unity.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And over all these virtues put on love, which binds them all together in perfect unity.

declarations.text: My love for others is the proof that I am a disciple of Jesus.
declarations.bibleVerseText: By this everyone will know that you are my disciples, if you love one another.

declarations.text: I am compassionate and tenderhearted, forgiving others just as Christ forgave me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Be kind and compassionate to one another, forgiving each other, just as in Christ God forgave you.

declarations.text: I show my love through my actions and my truth, not just my words.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Dear children, let us not love with words or speech but with actions and in truth.

declarations.text: I am full of the Holy Spirit who pours God's love into my heart every day.
declarations.bibleVerseText: God’s love has been poured out into our hearts through the Holy Spirit.

declarations.text: I am a person of grace, always speaking words that build others up in love.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Let your conversation be always full of grace, seasoned with salt.

declarations.text: I follow the example of Christ and walk in the way of sacrificial love.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Follow God’s example, therefore, as dearly loved children and walk in the way of love, just as Christ loved us.

declarations.text: I am an overcomer because God’s love gives me the victory over hatred and division.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.

declarations.text: I find my worth in being God’s beloved and not in the opinions of others.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord your God is with you... He will take great delight in you; in his love he will no longer rebuke you, but will rejoice over you with singing.

declarations.text: I choose love above every gift and every ambition because without love I am nothing.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And now these three remain: faith, hope and love. But the greatest of these is love.

declarations.text: I belong to God and I walk in the authority He already gave me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Yet to all who did receive him, to those who believed in his name, he gave the right to become children of God.

declarations.text: God studied every detail of me before I drew my first breath and He called what He made fearfully.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I praise you because I am fearfully and wonderfully made; your works are wonderful, I know that full well.

declarations.text: I carry God's glory into every room I enter because He actually lives inside me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You are the light of the world. A town built on a hill cannot be hidden.

declarations.text: I am no longer a slave to fear because I am a son/daughter of the Most High.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For you did not receive a spirit that makes you a slave again to fear, but you received the spirit of sonship.

declarations.text: I am a royal priest and a member of a holy nation, set apart for God's glory.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But you are a chosen people, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, God’s special possession.

declarations.text: I am the righteousness of God in Christ Jesus, justified and made whole.
declarations.bibleVerseText: God made him who had no sin to be sin for us, so that in him we might become the righteousness of God.

declarations.text: I am a temple of the Holy Spirit, and God Himself lives inside of me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Do you not know that your bodies are temples of the Holy Spirit, who is in you?

declarations.text: I am chosen and handpicked by God before the world was even created.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For he chose us in him before the creation of the world to be holy and blameless in his sight.

declarations.text: I am more than a conqueror through Him who loves me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: No, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him who loved us.

declarations.text: I am the intentional work of the living God, crafted with purpose.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For we are God's handiwork, created in Christ Jesus to do good works, which God prepared in advance for us to do.

declarations.text: I am an heir of God and a co-heir with Christ to all the riches of heaven.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Now if we are children, then we are heirs—heirs of God and co-heirs with Christ.

declarations.text: I am strong not through willpower or self-discipline but because the Almighty God himself lives inside me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Finally, be strong in the Lord and in his mighty power.

declarations.text: I am hidden with Christ in God, and my life is secure in Him.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For you died, and your life is now hidden with Christ in God.

declarations.text: I am loved with an everlasting love that never lets me go.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I have loved you with an everlasting love; I have drawn you with unfailing kindness.

declarations.text: I no longer accept the labels the world gave me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord will make you the head, not the tail. If you pay attention to the commands of the Lord your God...you will always be at the top, never at the bottom.

declarations.text: I represent a King whose kingdom never ends and that is exactly who I am.
declarations.bibleVerseText: We are therefore Christ's ambassadors, as though God were making his appeal through us.

declarations.text: I am free from condemnation and I walk in total liberty.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Therefore, there is now no condemnation for those who are in Christ Jesus.

declarations.text: I am the salt of the earth and I bring God's truth to every space I occupy.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You are the salt of the earth. But if the salt loses its saltiness, how can it be made salty again?

declarations.text: I am not subject to the systems of this world.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But our citizenship is in heaven. And we eagerly await a Savior from there, the Lord Jesus Christ.

declarations.text: I am dead to sin and alive to God through Jesus Christ.
declarations.bibleVerseText: In the same way, count yourselves dead to sin but alive to God in Christ Jesus.

declarations.text: I am a friend of God, and He shares His heart with me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I no longer call you servants... Instead, I have called you friends.

declarations.text: I am sealed with the Holy Spirit of promise, guaranteed for glory.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You were marked in him with a seal, the promised Holy Spirit.

declarations.text: I speak words of life today, because my tongue has the power to create my future.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The tongue has the power of life and death, and those who love it will eat its fruit.

declarations.text: I set a guard over my mouth and I only say what is helpful and encouraging.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Set a guard over my mouth, Lord; keep watch over the door of my lips.

declarations.text: My words are like apples of gold in settings of silver—beautiful and well-timed.
declarations.bibleVerseText: A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in pictures of silver.

declarations.text: I use my speech to build others up and give grace to those who hear me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Do not let any unwholesome talk come out of your mouths, but only what is helpful for building others up.

declarations.text: The words of my mouth and the thoughts of my heart are pleasing to God.
declarations.bibleVerseText: May these words of my mouth and this meditation of my heart be pleasing in your sight.

declarations.text: I declare that I am healed, prosperous, and strong, regardless of what I see.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Let the weak say, 'I am strong.'

declarations.text: I am slow to speak and quick to listen, making my words count.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Everyone should be quick to listen, slow to speak and slow to become angry.

declarations.text: My conversation is always full of grace and seasoned with wisdom.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Let your conversation be always full of grace, seasoned with salt.

declarations.text: I call those things which do not exist as though they did.
declarations.bibleVerseText: God... calls into being things that were not.

declarations.text: I speak the truth in love and grow in maturity every day.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Instead, speaking the truth in love, we will grow to become in every respect the mature body.

declarations.text: My tongue is the pen of a ready writer, declaring the goodness of God.
declarations.bibleVerseText: My tongue is the pen of a skillful writer.

declarations.text: I refuse to complain; I choose to speak words of thanksgiving instead.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Do everything without grumbling or arguing.

declarations.text: My words bring healing to my body and to those around me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The tongue of the wise brings healing.

declarations.text: I have the tongue of the learned, and I know how to speak a word in season to the weary.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Sovereign Lord has given me a well-instructed tongue, to know the word that sustains the weary.

declarations.text: I am a person of integrity; my 'yes' is yes and my 'no' is no.
declarations.bibleVerseText: All you need to say is simply ‘Yes’ or ‘No’.

declarations.text: I speak words that are sweet to the soul and healthy for my bones.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Gracious words are a honeycomb, sweet to the soul and healing to the bones.

declarations.text: I choose to be silent rather than speak words of anger.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Even fools are thought wise if they keep silent.

declarations.text: I declare the promises of God over my life and I see them manifest.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You will also declare a thing, and it will be established for you.

declarations.text: My mouth is a fountain of life that brings refreshment to others.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The mouth of the righteous is a fountain of life.

declarations.text: I answer others with a soft word that turns away wrath.
declarations.bibleVerseText: A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.

declarations.text: I speak with wisdom and the law of kindness is on my tongue.
declarations.bibleVerseText: She speaks with wisdom, and faithful instruction is on her tongue.

declarations.text: The Spirit of the Lord speaks through me; His word is on my tongue.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Spirit of the Lord spoke through me; his word was on my tongue.

declarations.text: I prophesy hope and victory over every dry area of my life.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Then he said to me, 'Prophesy to these bones and say to them, Dry bones, hear the word of the Lord!'

declarations.text: My words are powerful and they will not return to me empty.
declarations.bibleVerseText: So is my word that goes out from my mouth: It will not return to me empty, but will accomplish what I desire.

declarations.text: I am justified by my words and I walk in the favor of God.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For by your words you will be acquitted, and by your words you will be condemned.

declarations.text: I have a bright future because God has planned good things for my life.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For I know the plans I have for you, declares the Lord, plans to prosper you and not to harm you, plans to give you hope and a future.

declarations.text: I am full of joy and peace because I trust in the God of hope.
declarations.bibleVerseText: May the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace as you trust in him, so that you may overflow with hope by the power of the Holy Spirit.

declarations.text: I expect good things to happen today because God is working for my benefit.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And we know that in all things God works for the good of those who love him, who have been called according to his purpose.

declarations.text: I am not discouraged because God is the one who keeps my head held high.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But you, Lord, are a shield around me, my glory, the One who lifts my head high.

declarations.text: I hold my hope without wavering — not because I am strong, but because the One who promised is faithful.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Let us hold unswervingly to the hope we profess, for he who promised is faithful.

declarations.text: My strength is renewed every day as I put my hope in the Lord.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But those who hope in the Lord will renew their strength. They will soar on wings like eagles.

declarations.text: I refuse to give up. I see God's goodness in my life.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I remain confident of this: I will see the goodness of the Lord in the land of the living.

declarations.text: I have a solid anchor for my soul that keeps me steady through any storm.
declarations.bibleVerseText: We have this hope as an anchor for the soul, firm and secure.

declarations.text: I look forward with excitement because the best days of my life are still ahead of me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The glory of this present house will be greater than the glory of the former house, says the Lord Almighty.

declarations.text: I am not put to shame because God’s love has been poured into my heart.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And hope does not put us to shame, because God’s love has been poured out into our hearts.

declarations.text: I choose to be brave and strong because my hope is fixed on the Lord.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Be strong and take heart, all you who hope in the Lord.

declarations.text: I believe that every difficult situation will eventually turn around for my good.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You intended to harm me, but God intended it for good to accomplish what is now being done.

declarations.text: I am full of confidence because God will never leave me or let me down.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Be strong and courageous. Do not be afraid or terrified because of them, for the Lord your God goes with you; he will never leave you nor forsake you.

declarations.text: I find my hope in the Word of God which stands true forever.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You are my refuge and my shield; I have put my hope in your word.

declarations.text: I am patient in times of trouble because I am joyful in my hope.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Be joyful in hope, patient in affliction, faithful in prayer.

declarations.text: I look for the light in every situation because God is my salvation.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord is my light and my salvation—whom shall I fear?

declarations.text: I am a prisoner of hope and I expect God to restore double to me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Return to your fortress, you prisoners of hope; even now I announce that I will restore twice as much to you.

declarations.text: I know that my current troubles are small compared to the glory that is coming.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For our light and momentary troubles are achieving for us an eternal glory that far outweighs them all.

declarations.text: I am confident that God will finish the good work He started in me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Being confident of this, that he who began a good work in you will carry it on to completion.

declarations.text: I trust that God will meet all my needs according to His great riches.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And my God will meet all your needs according to the riches of his glory in Christ Jesus.

declarations.text: I wake up with hope because God’s mercies are brand new every morning.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Because of the Lord’s great love we are not consumed... his compassions never fail. They are new every morning.

declarations.text: I refuse to worry because I know God is taking care of my future.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Therefore do not worry about tomorrow, for tomorrow will worry about itself.

declarations.text: I walk in hope because I am a child of the light and not of the darkness.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But since we belong to the day, let us be sober, putting on faith and love as a breastplate, and the hope of salvation as a helmet.

declarations.text: I keep my eyes on what is coming and not on the problems I see right now.
declarations.bibleVerseText: So we fix our eyes not on what is seen, but on what is unseen, since what is seen is temporary, but what is unseen is eternal.

declarations.text: I am filled with a living hope through the power of God's victory.
declarations.bibleVerseText: In his great mercy he has given us new birth into a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead.

declarations.text: My joy flows from a source inside me that no circumstance can affect and no trial can ever reach.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Consider it pure joy, my brothers and sisters, whenever you face trials of many kinds, because you know that the testing of your faith produces perseverance.

declarations.text: I have a deep joy inside me that the world did not give and cannot take away.
declarations.bibleVerseText: So with you: Now is your time of grief, but I will see you again and you will rejoice, and no one will take away your joy.

declarations.text: I wake up with a song of praise because God has turned my sadness into dancing.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You turned my wailing into dancing; you removed my sackcloth and clothed me with joy.

declarations.text: My problems have no authority over the joy God placed inside me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Though the fig tree does not bud and there are no grapes on the vines...yet I will rejoice in the Lord, I will be joyful in God my Savior.

declarations.text: I am full of joy because I am constantly in the presence of the Lord.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You make known to me the path of life; you will fill me with joy in your presence.

declarations.text: Rejoicing is a command I walk in daily and as I obey it I always find my way back.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Rejoice always, pray continually, give thanks in all circumstances; for this is God's will for you in Christ Jesus.

declarations.text: I have a glad heart which works like good medicine for my body and mind.
declarations.bibleVerseText: A cheerful heart is good medicine, but a crushed spirit dries up the bones.

declarations.text: I overflow with hope and joy through the power of the Holy Spirit living in me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: May the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace as you trust in him.

declarations.text: I do not carry a troubled heart.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Do not let your hearts be troubled. You believe in God; believe also in me.

declarations.text: I find joy in the middle of trouble because I know my victory is coming.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Weeping may stay for the night, but rejoicing comes in the morning.

declarations.text: My joy comes from God and no loss, no person, no setback can touch it.
declarations.bibleVerseText: A cheerful heart is good medicine, but a crushed spirit dries up the bones.

declarations.text: I am filled with a joy that is too wonderful for words to describe.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Though you have not seen him, you love him... and are filled with an inexpressible and glorious joy.

declarations.text: God fills my soul to overflowing so what He pours into me spills onto others.
declarations.bibleVerseText: May the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace as you trust in him, so that you may overflow with hope by the power of the Holy Spirit.

declarations.text: I rejoice in the Lord again and again because He is endlessly and completely worth celebrating.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Rejoice in the Lord always. I will say it again: Rejoice!

declarations.text: I am walking inside God's kingdom where the currency is righteousness, peace, and joy rather than anxiety, striving, or performance.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For the kingdom of God is not a matter of eating and drinking, but of righteousness, peace and joy in the Holy Spirit.

declarations.text: Serving others fills me rather than draining me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Your love has given me great joy and encouragement, because you, brother, have refreshed the hearts of the Lord's people.

declarations.text: I am joyful even while waiting and even while suffering.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Be joyful in hope, patient in affliction, faithful in prayer.

declarations.text: I celebrate every small win because I know God is leading me to big victories.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Do not despise these small beginnings, for the Lord rejoices to see the work begin.

declarations.text: I feed my mind on truth, beauty, and goodness.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Whatever is true, whatever is noble, whatever is right, whatever is pure, whatever is lovely...think about such things.

declarations.text: I have a steady joy because I know that God will never leave me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Be strong and courageous... for the Lord your God goes with you; he will never leave you nor forsake you.

declarations.text: Every day God has made is a gift I choose to fully receive, unwrap, and live rather than merely survive.
declarations.bibleVerseText: This is the day the Lord has made; let us rejoice and be glad in it.

declarations.text: I am satisfied and joyful because God satisfies my soul with good things.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For he satisfies the thirsty and fills the hungry with good things.

declarations.text: I am already healed because of the wounds that Jesus took for me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: He himself bore our sins in his body on the cross... by his wounds you have been healed.

declarations.text: I refuse to accept sickness because the Lord has taken all disease away from me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord will keep you free from every disease.

declarations.text: I command every organ and cell in my body to function in perfect health right now.
declarations.bibleVerseText: He sent out his word and healed them; he rescued them from the grave.

declarations.text: I live a long and full life and I do not die before my time.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I will not die but live, and will proclaim what the Lord has done.

declarations.text: God is restoring my health and healing all of my wounds today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But I will restore you to health and heal your wounds, declares the Lord.

declarations.text: I have a sharp mind and a strong body because God gives me life and energy.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For God has not given us a spirit of fear, but of power and of love and of a sound mind.

declarations.text: I speak to my body and command it to be strong and full of vitality.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Let the weak say, 'I am strong.'

declarations.text: My youth is renewed like the eagle and my strength increases every day.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Who satisfies your desires with good things so that your youth is renewed like the eagle’s.

declarations.text: I walk in divine health because the Spirit of God lives inside of me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And if the Spirit of him who raised Jesus from the dead is living in you, he... will also give life to your mortal bodies.

declarations.text: I refuse to let symptoms discourage me because I trust in the Great Physician.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Is there no balm in Gilead? Is there no physician there? Why then is there no healing for the wound of my people?

declarations.text: I call forth health in my bones and strength in my muscles right now.
declarations.bibleVerseText: This will bring health to your body and nourishment to your bones.

declarations.text: I am free from pain because Jesus carried all my sicknesses and sorrows.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Surely he took up our pain and bore our suffering.

declarations.text: I choose to think about life and health instead of focusing on sickness.
declarations.bibleVerseText: My son, pay attention to what I say... for they are life to those who find them and health to one’s whole body.

declarations.text: God satisfies me with a long life and shows me His saving power in my body.
declarations.bibleVerseText: With long life I will satisfy him and show him my salvation.

declarations.text: I am blessed with health in my home and strength in my physical frame.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Worship the Lord your God, and his blessing will be on your food and water. I will take away sickness from among you.

declarations.text: I declare that every part of my body is a temple of the Holy Spirit and must be healthy.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Do you not know that your bodies are temples of the Holy Spirit?

declarations.text: I eat and drink with gratitude, knowing my body is God's temple — and He keeps His temple in health.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Do you not know that your bodies are temples of the Holy Spirit, who is in you?

declarations.text: I refuse to fear any virus or plague because I am protected by God.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You will not fear the terror of night... nor the plague that destroys at midday.

declarations.text: Healing is the children's bread — I am God's child and I take what is mine through Christ's wounds.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But he was pierced for our transgressions... and by his wounds we are healed.

declarations.text: I command my immune system to be strong and to protect my body from all harm.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord is my strength and my shield; my heart trusts in him, and he helps me.

declarations.text: I have the peace of God which keeps my heart and my body in perfect health.
declarations.bibleVerseText: A tranquil heart gives life to the body.

declarations.text: I receive the power of God today to heal every sickness and every disease in me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: He gave them power and authority to drive out all demons and to cure diseases.

declarations.text: I walk in the light and my body is full of the life of God.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The eye is the lamp of the body. If your eyes are healthy, your whole body will be full of light.

declarations.text: I am a new person in Christ and sickness has no legal right to stay in my body.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Therefore, if anyone is in Christ, the new creation has come.

declarations.text: I thank God for my healing even before I see the final results with my eyes.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Therefore I tell you, whatever you ask for in prayer, believe that you have received it, and it will be yours.

declarations.text: I am protected by the full armor of God and I stand firm against every plan of the enemy.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Put on the full armor of God, so that you can take your stand against the devil’s schemes.

declarations.text: No weapon formed against me will be successful because God is my defender.
declarations.bibleVerseText: No weapon forged against you will prevail, and you will refute every tongue that accuses you.

declarations.text: I have the power to crush every obstacle because God has placed the enemy under my feet.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I have given you authority to trample on snakes and scorpions and to overcome all the power of the enemy.

declarations.text: I am a conqueror through Christ and I win every battle that comes my way.
declarations.bibleVerseText: No, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him who loved us.

declarations.text: The Lord is a warrior and He is fighting on my behalf right now.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord is a warrior; the Lord is his name.

declarations.text: I use the sword of the Spirit which is the Word of God to defeat every lie.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Take the helmet of salvation and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God.

declarations.text: I am not afraid of ten thousand enemies because God is a shield around me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I will not fear though tens of thousands assail me on every side.

declarations.text: I pull down every mental stronghold that tries to stop me from following God.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The weapons we fight with are not the weapons of the world... they have divine power to demolish strongholds.

declarations.text: I resist the devil and he must run away from me in terror.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Submit yourselves, then, to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.

declarations.text: I am strong in the Lord and in His mighty power today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Finally, be strong in the Lord and in his mighty power.

declarations.text: I am surrounded by an army of angels that protect me wherever I go.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For he will command his angels concerning you to guard you in all your ways.

declarations.text: I speak to the mountains in my life and I command them to be removed.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Truly I tell you, if anyone says to this mountain, 'Go, throw yourself into the sea,' and does not doubt in their heart... it will be done.

declarations.text: I am hidden in the secret place of God where the enemy cannot find me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For in the day of trouble he will keep me safe in his dwelling; he will hide me in the shelter of his sacred tent.

declarations.text: I bind every spirit of confusion and I loose the peace of God over my mind.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Truly I tell you, whatever you bind on earth will be bound in heaven.

declarations.text: The Spirit of God inside me is much greater than any power in the world.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You, dear children, are from God and have overcome them, because the one who is in you is greater than the one who is in the world.

declarations.text: I am of good cheer because Jesus has already overcome the world for me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: In this world you will have trouble. But take heart! I have overcome the world.

declarations.text: I am a soldier for God and I do not get distracted by the things of this world.
declarations.bibleVerseText: No one serving as a soldier gets involved in civilian affairs; rather, they try to please their commanding officer.

declarations.text: I wear the helmet of salvation to protect my thoughts from every attack.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And take the helmet of salvation.

declarations.text: I use the shield of faith to stop every flaming arrow that the enemy shoots at me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: In addition to all this, take up the shield of faith, with which you can extinguish all the flaming arrows of the evil one.

declarations.text: I am always triumphant because God leads me to victory in every situation.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But thanks be to God, who always leads us as captives in Christ’s triumphal procession.

declarations.text: I forbid any spirit of fear from staying in my home or my life.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For God has not given us a spirit of fear, but of power and of love and of a sound mind.

declarations.text: I am safe because the name of the Lord is a strong tower that I run into.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The name of the Lord is a fortified tower; the righteous run to it and are safe.

declarations.text: I walk in light and the darkness has no power to overcome me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The light shines in the darkness, and the darkness has not overcome it.

declarations.text: I am bold as a lion because I know that I am right with God.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The wicked flee though no one pursues, but the righteous are as bold as a lion.

declarations.text: I give thanks to God who gives me the victory through Jesus Christ.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But thanks be to God! He gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.

declarations.text: I have the mind of Christ and I make smart decisions in every area of my life.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For, 'Who has known the mind of the Lord so as to instruct him?' But we have the mind of Christ.

declarations.text: I am full of wisdom because I ask God for it and He gives it to me freely.
declarations.bibleVerseText: If any of you lacks wisdom, you should ask God, who gives generously to all without finding fault.

declarations.text: I am not limited to my own intelligence.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The way of fools seems right to them, but the wise listen to advice.

declarations.text: I know when to speak and when to be still.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Even fools are thought wise if they keep silent, and discerning if they hold their tongues.

declarations.text: I have great understanding because I choose to respect and honor the Lord.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom, and knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.

declarations.text: I am a builder who founds my life on the solid rock of God's Word.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Everyone who hears these words of mine and puts them into practice is like a wise man who built his house on the rock.

declarations.text: I know how to solve difficult problems because God’s Spirit gives me special insight.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I have heard that the spirit of the gods is in you and that you have insight, intelligence and outstanding wisdom.

declarations.text: I am a wise steward of my time and I make the most of every opportunity.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Be very careful, then, how you live—not as unwise but as wise, making the most of every opportunity.

declarations.text: God has sharpened my discernment so that I see danger before it arrives and move with foresight rather than regret.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The prudent see danger and take refuge, but the simple keep going and pay the penalty.

declarations.text: God has filled my mouth with words that bring healing and direction.
declarations.bibleVerseText: She speaks with wisdom, and faithful instruction is on her tongue.

declarations.text: I am not stuck with the wisdom I was born with.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Walk with the wise and become wise, for a companion of fools suffers harm.

declarations.text: I am a faithful steward who builds with deliberate intention toward what will last.
declarations.bibleVerseText: In the house of the wise are stores of choice food and olive oil, but a foolish man devours all he has.

declarations.text: I am quick to listen and slow to speak which keeps me in a place of peace.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Everyone should be quick to listen, slow to speak and slow to become angry.

declarations.text: I have divine strategy for my business and my work because God directs me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I, wisdom, dwell together with prudence; I possess knowledge and discretion.

declarations.text: I am a peacemaker because the wisdom from heaven is gentle and kind.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But the wisdom that comes from heaven is first of all pure; then peace-loving, considerate, submissive, full of mercy.

declarations.text: Through wisdom and understanding I am not just building for myself but establishing something that will outlast my lifetime.
declarations.bibleVerseText: By wisdom a house is built, and through understanding it is established.

declarations.text: I do not spend my days carelessly.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Teach us to number our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom.

declarations.text: God equipped me with specific skill for this exact season and I am excellent at what He called me to.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For the Lord gives wisdom; from his mouth come knowledge and understanding.

declarations.text: I am surrounded by people who carry God's wisdom and together we win battles that would destroy any one.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.

declarations.text: I am protected from making bad choices because wisdom guards my path.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Discretion will protect you, and understanding will guard you.

declarations.text: In the moments that matter most God gives me exactly the right words and I speak with a precision.
declarations.bibleVerseText: A person finds joy in giving an apt reply — and how good is a timely word!

declarations.text: My life does not just talk about walking with God but produces visible fruit in every area.
declarations.bibleVerseText: We pray this in order that you may live a life worthy of the Lord and please him in every way: bearing fruit in every good work, growing in the knowledge of God.

declarations.text: I praise the Lord every single day and I sing to Him all my life.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I will praise the Lord all my life; I will sing praise to my God as long as I live.

declarations.text: I enter into God's presence with a thankful heart and a loud song of joy.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Enter his gates with thanksgiving and his courts with praise.

declarations.text: I choose to bless the Lord at all times and never stop speaking His praise.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I will extol the Lord at all times; his praise will always be on my lips.

declarations.text: I am full of joy because I know that God is good and His love lasts forever.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good; his love endures forever.

declarations.text: I praise God even when things are hard because He is always worthy of it.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Through Jesus, therefore, let us continually offer to God a sacrifice of praise.

declarations.text: I celebrate God’s victory in my life with a shout of joy and triumph.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Clap your hands, all you nations; shout to God with cries of joy.

declarations.text: I am always thankful because I know that every good gift comes from God.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Every good and perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of the heavenly lights.

declarations.text: I glorify God with my whole heart and I tell everyone about His miracles.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I will give thanks to you, Lord, with all my heart; I will tell of all your wonderful deeds.

declarations.text: I use my voice to sing about the greatness and the power of my God.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I will sing to the Lord, for he is highly exalted.

declarations.text: I am a light for God because I am always full of gratitude and praise.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Let your light shine before others, that they may see your good deeds and glorify your Father in heaven.

declarations.text: I find strength in my praise because God lives in the middle of my worship.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But you are holy, you who inhabit the praises of Israel.

declarations.text: I praise God for His amazing works and His incredible greatness in my life.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Praise him for his acts of power; praise him for his surpassing greatness.

declarations.text: I wake up and give thanks to the Lord because He has been so good to me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: It is good to praise the Lord and make music to your name, O Most High, proclaiming your love in the morning.

declarations.text: I am full of hope because I spend my time thanking God for what He has done.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I will remember the deeds of the Lord; yes, I will remember your miracles of long ago.

declarations.text: I dance and sing before the Lord because He has given me total victory.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Then Miriam the prophet... led all the women out and they danced.

declarations.text: I praise the Lord because He has rescued me from all of my fears.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I sought the Lord, and he answered me; he delivered me from all my fears.

declarations.text: I am a person of praise and I refuse to complain about my situation.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Do everything without grumbling or arguing.

declarations.text: I give thanks in every circumstance because I know God is in control.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Give thanks in all circumstances; for this is God’s will for you in Christ Jesus.

declarations.text: I praise God with my whole body and everything inside of me blesses His name.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Praise the Lord, my soul; all my inmost being, praise his holy name.

declarations.text: I am happy and successful because I keep my heart focused on praising God.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Blessed are those who have learned to acclaim you, who walk in the light of your presence, Lord.

declarations.text: I celebrate God’s love every morning and His faithfulness every single night.
declarations.bibleVerseText: To proclaim your love in the morning and your faithfulness at night.

declarations.text: I shout for joy to the Lord because He is the King of the whole earth.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Shout for joy to the Lord, all the earth, burst into jubilant song with music.

declarations.text: I never forget the many blessings God has given to me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Praise the Lord, my soul, and forget not all his benefits.

declarations.text: I praise God because His word is true and it guides me in the right direction.
declarations.bibleVerseText: In God, whose word I praise—in God I trust and am not afraid.

declarations.text: I end my day with praise because everything that has breath should praise the Lord.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Let everything that has breath praise the Lord. Praise the Lord.

declarations.text: I do exactly what God tells me to do because I love Him and I trust Him.
declarations.bibleVerseText: If you love me, keep my commands.

declarations.text: I am successful and blessed in everything I do because I follow God's instructions.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Now that you know these things, you will be blessed if you do them.

declarations.text: I choose to obey God quickly because I know His timing is perfect for my life.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I will hasten and not delay to obey your commands.

declarations.text: I listen to the voice of God and I refuse to follow the wrong path.
declarations.bibleVerseText: My sheep listen to my voice; I know them, and they follow me.

declarations.text: I am the head and not the tail because I am faithful to God's Word.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord will make you the head, not the tail... if you pay attention to the commands of the Lord your God.

declarations.text: I choose to please God more than I try to please other people.
declarations.bibleVerseText: We must obey God rather than human beings!

declarations.text: I walk in freedom and power because I keep my heart aligned with God's truth.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I will walk about in freedom, for I have sought out your precepts.

declarations.text: I am a doer of the Word and not just someone who listens to it.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Do not merely listen to the word, and so deceive yourselves. Do what it says.

declarations.text: I am a friend of God because I do what He has commanded me to do.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You are my friends if you do what I command.

declarations.text: I find great reward and peace as I live a life of total obedience.
declarations.bibleVerseText: In keeping them there is great reward.

declarations.text: I trust God to lead me and I follow Him into my great future.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Whether you turn to the right or to the left, your ears will hear a voice behind you, saying, 'This is the way; walk in it.'

declarations.text: I keep my focus on God's ways and I am never put to shame.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Then I would not be put to shame when I consider all your commands.

declarations.text: I am a wise person because I hear God's words and I put them into practice.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Therefore everyone who hears these words of mine and puts them into practice is like a wise man who built his house on the rock.

declarations.text: I delight in doing God's will and His law is written deep in my heart.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I desire to do your will, my God; your law is within my heart.

declarations.text: I am strong and courageous because I do not turn away from God's commands.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Be strong and very courageous. Be careful to obey all the law... do not turn from it to the right or to the left.

declarations.text: I know that my obedience is better than any other gift I could offer God.
declarations.bibleVerseText: To obey is better than sacrifice.

declarations.text: I walk in the light and I have fellowship with God as I obey Him.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another.

declarations.text: I am a light to the world because my life shows the power of obeying God.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Let your light shine before others, that they may see your good deeds and glorify your Father in heaven.

declarations.text: I am growing in grace and knowledge because I am faithful to what God says.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Whoever has my commands and keeps them is the one who loves me.

declarations.text: I eat the good of the land because I am willing and obedient to the Lord.
declarations.bibleVerseText: If you are willing and obedient, you will eat the good things of the land.

declarations.text: I am a faithful servant and I am entering into the joy of my Lord.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Well done, good and faithful servant! You have been faithful with a few things; I will put you in charge of many things.

declarations.text: I have a clear conscience because I choose to do what is right every day.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Pray for us. We are sure that we have a clear conscience and desire to live honorably in every way.

declarations.text: I am protected and safe because I listen to the wisdom of God.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But whoever listens to me will live in safety and be at ease, without fear of harm.

declarations.text: I am strong in the Lord because I put His words into action in my life.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But the people who know their God will firmly resist him and take action.

declarations.text: I live a life of purpose and power by following God's plan for me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For we are God’s handiwork, created in Christ Jesus to do good works.

declarations.text: I have a clean heart and a right spirit because God is working in me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Create in me a pure heart, O God, and renew a steadfast spirit within me.

declarations.text: I can see God clearly because my heart is pure and my focus is on Him.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Blessed are the pure in heart, for they will see God.

declarations.text: I keep my way pure by living according to the Word of God.
declarations.bibleVerseText: How can a young person stay on the path of purity? By living according to your word.

declarations.text: I am a temple of the Holy Spirit and I honor God with my body.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Do you not know that your bodies are temples of the Holy Spirit... Therefore honor God with your bodies.

declarations.text: I think about things that are excellent and pure so my mind stays strong.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Finally, brothers and sisters, whatever is true... whatever is pure... think about such things.

declarations.text: I am a new person in Christ and I leave all old habits behind me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Therefore, if anyone is in Christ, the new creation has come: The old has gone, the new is here!

declarations.text: I guard my heart above everything else because it is the source of my life.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Above all else, guard your heart, for everything you do flows from it.

declarations.text: I am a vessel of honor and I am prepared for every good work God has for me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Those who cleanse themselves from the latter will be instruments for special purposes... prepared to do any good work.

declarations.text: I walk in the light and I refuse to hide anything in the darkness.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another.

declarations.text: I set no evil thing before my eyes because I choose to stay pure.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I will not look with approval on anything that is vile.

declarations.text: I am washed and made clean by the power of Jesus Christ.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But you were washed, you were sanctified, you were justified in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ.

declarations.text: I run away from wrong desires and I chase after righteousness and peace.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Flee the evil desires of youth and pursue righteousness, faith, love and peace.

declarations.text: I have clean hands and a pure heart as I stand in God's presence.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The one who has clean hands and a pure heart... will receive blessing from the Lord.

declarations.text: I am transformed by renewing my mind with the truth of God's Word.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Do not conform to the pattern of this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind.

declarations.text: I use my speech to build others up and I keep my words pure.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Do not let any unwholesome talk come out of your mouths, but only what is helpful for building others up.

declarations.text: I am a child of God and I keep myself pure just as He is pure.
declarations.bibleVerseText: All who have this hope in him purify themselves, just as he is pure.

declarations.text: I am strong because I have victory over the world and its temptations.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For everyone born of God overcomes the world. This is the victory that has overcome the world, even our faith.

declarations.text: I offer my whole life to God as a living and holy sacrifice.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Therefore, I urge you... to offer your bodies as a living sacrifice, holy and pleasing to God.

declarations.text: I am clothed in the righteousness of God and I walk with dignity.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I delight greatly in the Lord... for he has clothed me with garments of salvation and arrayed me in a robe of his righteousness.

declarations.text: I refuse to be weighed down by guilt because I am made pure by God's grace.
declarations.bibleVerseText: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just and will forgive us our sins and purify us from all unrighteousness.

declarations.text: I am a light in this world and I shine with the purity of Christ.
declarations.bibleVerseText: So that you may become blameless and pure, 'children of God without fault in a warped and crooked generation.'

declarations.text: I have the power to say no to things that hurt my soul and yes to God's best.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For the grace of God has appeared... It teaches us to say 'No' to ungodliness and worldly passions.

declarations.text: I am a friend of God because I love a pure heart and kind speech.
declarations.bibleVerseText: One who loves a pure heart and who speaks with grace will have the king for a friend.

declarations.text: I am protected and safe because I walk in integrity and truth.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Whoever walks in integrity walks securely, but whoever takes crooked paths will be found out.

declarations.text: I am full of life and health because I keep my heart and mind pure.
declarations.bibleVerseText: A tranquil heart gives life to the body.

declarations.text: I choose to be thankful in every situation because I know God is in control.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Give thanks in all circumstances; for this is God’s will for you in Christ Jesus.

declarations.text: I wake up with a grateful heart because God’s mercies are new every morning.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Because of the Lord’s great love we are not consumed... his compassions never fail. They are new every morning.

declarations.text: I never forget all the good things God has done for me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Praise the Lord, my soul, and forget not all his benefits.

declarations.text: I overflow with joy because I remember — God has been too faithful for me to stay silent.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Praise the Lord, my soul, and forget not all his benefits.

declarations.text: I refuse to complain and I choose to speak about how good God is.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I will give thanks to you, Lord, with all my heart; I will tell of all your wonderful deeds.

declarations.text: I find joy in the ordinary.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Every good and perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of the heavenly lights.

declarations.text: I thank God for my food and my health because He provides everything I need.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Worship the Lord your God, and his blessing will be on your food and water.

declarations.text: I enter into my day with a shout of thanks because God is faithful.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Enter his gates with thanksgiving and his courts with praise.

declarations.text: I am not anxious about anything because I bring my requests to God with thanks.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Do not be anxious about anything, but in every situation... with thanksgiving, present your requests to God.

declarations.text: I thank God for the people in my life who love and support me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I thank my God every time I remember you.

declarations.text: I am growing in faith because I am always abounding in thanksgiving.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Rooted and built up in him, strengthened in the faith as you were taught, and overflowing with thankfulness.

declarations.text: I focus on what I have instead of what I lack and I am satisfied.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But godliness with contentment is great gain.

declarations.text: I thank God for the victory even before I see it with my eyes.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But thanks be to God! He gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.

declarations.text: I am peaceful because I let the peace of God rule my heart with thankfulness.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Let the peace of Christ rule in your hearts... And be thankful.

declarations.text: I tell the story of God’s kindness to everyone I meet.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Give thanks to the Lord, call on his name; make known among the nations what he has done.

declarations.text: I have a cheerful heart which makes my whole life feel like a feast.
declarations.bibleVerseText: All the days of the oppressed are wretched, but the cheerful heart has a continual feast.

declarations.text: I thank God for His Word which gives me light and direction.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Your word is a lamp for my feet, a light on my path.

declarations.text: I am grateful for God’s protection over my home and my family.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord is my strength and my shield; my heart trusts in him, and he helps me.

declarations.text: I give thanks to the Lord because His love for me will never end.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good; his love endures forever.

declarations.text: I am content in every season of my life because God is with me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I have learned to be content whatever the circumstances.

declarations.text: I thank God for the strength to work and provide for my needs.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But remember the Lord your God, for it is he who gives you the ability to produce wealth.

declarations.text: I celebrate the beauty of God’s creation and I am thankful to be alive.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The heavens declare the glory of God; the skies proclaim the work of his hands.

declarations.text: I live a life of worship because I am so grateful for God’s grace.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Therefore, since we are receiving a kingdom that cannot be shaken, let us be thankful.

declarations.text: I refuse to let a day go by without saying thank you to my Father.
declarations.bibleVerseText: It is good to praise the Lord and make music to your name, O Most High.

declarations.text: I end my day with a grateful spirit and I sleep in perfect peace.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I will lie down and sleep in peace, for you alone, Lord, make me dwell in safety.

declarations.text: I have a strong and happy marriage because God is the foundation of our home.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Though one may be overpowered, two can defend themselves. A cord of three strands is not quickly broken.

declarations.text: I choose to love my spouse with a patient and kind heart every single day.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Love is patient, love is kind. It does not envy, it does not boast, it is not proud.

declarations.text: I am a blessing to my spouse and I always look for ways to help them.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord God said, 'It is not good for the man to be alone. I will make a helper suitable for him.'

declarations.text: I speak words of life and encouragement to my spouse at all times.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The tongue has the power of life and death, and those who love it will eat its fruit.

declarations.text: I forgive my spouse quickly and I refuse to hold onto any bitterness.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Be kind and compassionate to one another, forgiving each other, just as in Christ God forgave you.

declarations.text: Our marriage is full of peace because we let God's love lead our decisions.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Let the peace of Christ rule in your hearts, since as members of one body you were called to peace.

declarations.text: I honor my marriage and I stay faithful in my thoughts and my actions.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Marriage should be honored by all, and the marriage bed kept pure.

declarations.text: I am thankful for my spouse and I treat them as a precious gift from God.
declarations.bibleVerseText: He who finds a wife finds what is good and receives favor from the Lord.

declarations.text: I am slow to get angry and quick to listen when I talk with my spouse.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Everyone should be quick to listen, slow to speak and slow to become angry.

declarations.text: We are a united team and nothing can come between me and my spouse.
declarations.bibleVerseText: So they are no longer two, but one flesh. Therefore what God has joined together, let no one separate.

declarations.text: I trust God to heal and strengthen our relationship every day.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But I will restore you to health and heal your wounds, declares the Lord.

declarations.text: I put the needs of my spouse before my own because I choose to serve them.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Submit to one another out of reverence for Christ.

declarations.text: Our home is a place of joy where we laugh and grow together.
declarations.bibleVerseText: A cheerful heart is good medicine, but a crushed spirit dries up the bones.

declarations.text: I am a wise partner and I help build a great future for our family.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The wise woman builds her house, but with her own hands the foolish one tears hers down.

declarations.text: I pray for my spouse every day and I see God working in their life.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The prayer of a righteous person is powerful and effective.

declarations.text: I let go of past mistakes and I focus on the beautiful future of our marriage.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Forgetting what is behind and straining toward what is ahead.

declarations.text: I am patient with my spouse's flaws just as God is patient with mine.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Be completely humble and gentle; be patient, bearing with one another in love.

declarations.text: Our love for each other is getting stronger and deeper every single year.
declarations.bibleVerseText: May the Lord make your love increase and overflow for each other.

declarations.text: I guard our marriage by keeping our communication honest and open.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Therefore each of you must put off falsehood and speak truthfully to your neighbor.

declarations.text: I am a source of peace and comfort for my spouse in difficult times.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Therefore encourage one another and build each other up.

declarations.text: I refuse to let the sun go down while I am still angry with my spouse.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Do not let the sun go down while you are still angry.

declarations.text: God is protecting our marriage and keeping our hearts focused on Him.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord is faithful, and he will strengthen you and protect you from the evil one.

declarations.text: I treat my spouse with the same respect and honor that I give to the Lord.
declarations.bibleVerseText: However, each one of you also must love his wife as he loves himself, and the wife must respect her husband.

declarations.text: We are walking together in the plans that God has for our lives.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For I know the plans I have for you... plans to give you hope and a future.

declarations.text: I am confident that God will finish the good work He started in our marriage.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Being confident of this, that he who began a good work in you will carry it on to completion.

declarations.text: I am always safe because I live in the shadow of the Almighty God.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Whoever dwells in the shelter of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.

declarations.text: God is my shield and no weapon used against me will ever work.
declarations.bibleVerseText: No weapon forged against you will prevail.

declarations.text: I am protected from every danger because God’s angels are guarding me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For he will command his angels concerning you to guard you in all your ways.

declarations.text: I sleep in perfect peace tonight because the Lord is keeping me safe.
declarations.bibleVerseText: In peace I will lie down and sleep, for you alone, Lord, make me dwell in safety.

declarations.text: I have no fear of bad news because I trust God to take care of me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: They will have no fear of bad news; their hearts are steadfast, trusting in the Lord.

declarations.text: The Lord is my strong tower and I am safe whenever I run to Him.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The name of the Lord is a fortified tower; the righteous run to it and are safe.

declarations.text: God is right beside me and I am not shaken by anything.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I keep my eyes always on the Lord. With him at my right hand, I will not be shaken.

declarations.text: I am protected from all harm and God is watching over my life.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord will keep you from all harm—he will watch over your life.

declarations.text: God is a wall of fire around my home and my family.
declarations.bibleVerseText: 'And I myself will be a wall of fire around it,' declares the Lord, 'and I will be its glory within.'

declarations.text: I walk through difficult times without fear because I know God is with me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Even though I walk through the darkest valley, I will fear no evil, for you are with me.

declarations.text: I am safe from every trap and every sickness because God rescues me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Surely he will save you from the fowler’s snare and from the deadly pestilence.

declarations.text: I am hidden in the secret place of God where the enemy cannot reach me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For in the day of trouble he will keep me safe in his dwelling.

declarations.text: God protects me when I leave my house and when I come back home.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord will watch over your coming and going both now and forevermore.

declarations.text: I refuse to be afraid because God is my light and my salvation.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord is my light and my salvation—whom shall I fear?

declarations.text: I am surrounded by God’s favor like a shield protecting my whole life.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For you, Lord, bless the righteous; you surround them with your favor as with a shield.

declarations.text: No disaster will come near my home because God is my refuge.
declarations.bibleVerseText: No harm will overtake you, no disaster will come near your tent.

declarations.text: The Lord is faithful to strengthen me and protect me from the evil one.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But the Lord is faithful, and he will strengthen you and protect you from the evil one.

declarations.text: I am not afraid of the dark or any danger that happens during the day.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You will not fear the terror of night, nor the arrow that flies by day.

declarations.text: God is my hiding place and He protects me from every trouble.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You are my hiding place; you will protect me from trouble and surround me with songs of deliverance.

declarations.text: I have the peace of God which protects my heart and my thoughts.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And the peace of God... will guard your hearts and your minds in Christ Jesus.

declarations.text: I trust in the Lord and I am as safe as a mountain that cannot be moved.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Those who trust in the Lord are like Mount Zion, which cannot be shaken but endures forever.

declarations.text: The Lord is my rock and my fortress and I trust Him to keep me safe.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord is my rock, my fortress and my deliverer; my God is my rock, in whom I take refuge.

declarations.text: I walk in safety because I listen to the wisdom that God gives me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But whoever listens to me will live in safety and be at ease, without fear of harm.

declarations.text: I am a child of God and nothing can ever snatch me out of His hand.
declarations.bibleVerseText: No one will snatch them out of my hand.

declarations.text: I end my day with confidence because God is my helper and my protector.
declarations.bibleVerseText: So we say with confidence, 'The Lord is my helper; I will not be afraid.'

declarations.text: I am surrounded by God's favor like a shield that protects me everywhere I go.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For you, Lord, bless the righteous; you surround them with your favor as with a shield.

declarations.text: Doors are opening for me today that no person can shut.
declarations.bibleVerseText: What he opens no one can shut, and what he shuts no one can open.

declarations.text: I have favor with God and with every person I meet today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Then you will win favor and a good name in the sight of God and man.

declarations.text: God is making His face shine upon me and being gracious to me in everything I do.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord make his face shine on you and be gracious to you.

declarations.text: I receive special treatment and opportunities because I am a child of God.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But you are a chosen people, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, God’s special possession.

declarations.text: I am chosen by God to experience His goodness and His kindness.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But you, Israel, my servant... whom I have chosen.

declarations.text: I do not have to struggle for success because God’s favor gives me the advantage.
declarations.bibleVerseText: It was not by their sword that they won the land... it was your right hand, your arm, and the light of your face, for you loved them.

declarations.text: I am growing in favor and wisdom just like Jesus did.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And Jesus grew in wisdom and stature, and in favor with God and man.

declarations.text: I am highly favored and deeply loved by my Heavenly Father.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The angel went to her and said, 'Greetings, you who are highly favored! The Lord is with you.'

declarations.text: God is raising up people to help me reach my goals and my dreams.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord will grant that the enemies who rise up against you will be defeated before you.

declarations.text: I find favor in the eyes of those in authority over me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Now God had caused the official to show favor and compassion to Daniel.

declarations.text: I am always at the right place at the right time because God leads me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord will guide you always; he will satisfy your needs in a sun-scorched land.

declarations.text: I receive blessings today that I did not even have to work for.
declarations.bibleVerseText: So I gave you a land on which you did not toil and cities you did not build.

declarations.text: I walk in a level of favor that causes me to stand out from the crowd.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For who makes you different from anyone else? What do you have that you did not receive?

declarations.text: God’s favor is restoring everything that the enemy tried to steal from me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I will repay you for the years the locusts have eaten.

declarations.text: God's goodness and mercy actively pursue me — I don't chase blessings, they follow me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Surely your goodness and love will follow me all the days of my life.

declarations.text: I am promoted and honored because I am faithful to God.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For promotion cometh neither from the east, nor from the west... But God is the judge: he putteth down one, and setteth up another.

declarations.text: I have favor in my business and my career because God is my partner.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord was with Joseph so that he prospered.

declarations.text: I carry God's presence everywhere I go — and where He goes, favor follows.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord was with Joseph so that he prospered.

declarations.text: God is giving me favor today to finish every task with excellence.
declarations.bibleVerseText: May the favor of the Lord our God rest on us; establish the work of our hands for us.

declarations.text: I enjoy the favor of God which lasts for my entire lifetime.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For his anger lasts only a moment, but his favor lasts a lifetime.

declarations.text: I am blessed with favor that makes my name great in my community.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I will make you into a great nation, and I will bless you; I will make your name great.

declarations.text: I receive favor that brings me into the presence of great people.
declarations.bibleVerseText: A gift opens the way and ushers the giver into the presence of the great.

declarations.text: I am experiencing the year of the Lord’s favor in every part of my life.
declarations.bibleVerseText: To proclaim the year of the Lord’s favor.

declarations.text: I thank God for the favor that is resting on me and my family right now.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But Noah found favor in the eyes of the Lord.

declarations.text: God gives me the power and the ability to produce wealth.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But remember the Lord your God, for it is he who gives you the ability to produce wealth.

declarations.text: I am successful in everything I do because I meditate on God's Word.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Then you will be prosperous and successful.

declarations.text: I have more than enough to meet my needs and to help others in need.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And God is able to bless you abundantly, so that in all things at all times... you will abound in every good work.

declarations.text: God is opening the windows of heaven and pouring out a blessing I cannot contain.
declarations.bibleVerseText: See if I will not throw open the floodgates of heaven and pour out so much blessing that there will not be room enough to store it.

declarations.text: I am debt-free and I am the lender and not the borrower.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You will lend to many nations but will borrow from none.

declarations.text: Wealth and riches are in my house because I follow the ways of the Lord.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Wealth and riches are in their houses, and their righteousness endures forever.

declarations.text: Every business deal I touch turns into a great success because God is with me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord will send a blessing on your barns and on everything you put your hand to.

declarations.text: I have plenty of resources to finish every project God has given me.
